description: Find your own (non-archived) extraction jobs by condition: filename words, a module that produced output, jobs with warnings, or jobs waiting on a decision. Returns job ids, status, warning counts and which modules hold output, never module data: pass an id to the other tools (datasheetvend_explain_warnings, datasheetvend_compare_extractions, datasheetvend_search_document) or read GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}/<module>. totalMatched is counted after every filter: exact when scanComplete is true, otherwise a stated floor over the newest jobs scanned (countingNote). An empty list is a real answer. Reads the recorded state of your account's own jobs (owner, or TEAM-shared in your workspace; a refunded job is refused): nothing is extracted and no model is called. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key.

module.description: Only jobs where this module produced output.

only_needing_review.description: Only jobs waiting on a decision of yours.

only_with_warnings.description: Only jobs whose extraction raised at least one warning.
